title: 质数排列
summary: 把一到 n 排列，使质数必须位于质数下标，返回合法排列数对 10^9+7 取模。
insight: 若范围内有 p 个质数，则质数可在 p 个质数位置任意排列，非质数也可在其余 n-p 个位置任意排列，答案为 p!·(n-p)!。
pitfalls: 下标和数值范围都是一到 n
阶乘乘法过程持续取模

solutions.title: 筛法与两组阶乘
solutions.idea: 计数质数后独立排列质数与非质数。
steps: 埃氏筛标记 2..n 的质数并统计 primeCount
继续乘 (n-primeCount)! 并取模，返回结果

code.java: class Solution { public int numPrimeArrangements(int n){boolean[] prime=new boolean[n+1];Arrays.fill(prime,true);if(n>=0)prime[0]=false;if(n>=1)prime[1]=false;for(int value=2;value*value<=n;value++)if(prime[value])for(int multiple=value*value;multiple<=n;multiple+=value)prime[multiple]=false;int count=0;for(boolean value:prime)if(value)count++;long answer=1,mod=1000000007L;for(int value=2;value<=count;value++)answer=answer*value%mod;for(int value=2;value<=n-count;value++)answer=answer*value%mod;return (int)answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun numPrimeArrangements(n:Int):Int{val prime=BooleanArray(n+1){true};prime[0]=false;if(n>=1)prime[1]=false;var value=2;while(value*value<=n){if(prime[value])for(multiple in value*value..n step value)prime[multiple]=false;value++};val count=prime.count{it};val mod=1000000007L;var answer=1L;for(number in 2..count)answer=answer*number%mod;for(number in 2..n-count)answer=answer*number%mod;return answer.toInt()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int numPrimeArrangements(int n){vector<bool> prime(n+1,true);prime[0]=false;if(n>=1)prime[1]=false;for(int value=2;value*value<=n;++value)if(prime[value])for(int multiple=value*value;multiple<=n;multiple+=value)prime[multiple]=false;int count=count_if(prime.begin(),prime.end(),[](bool value){return value;});long long answer=1,mod=1000000007;for(int value=2;value<=count;++value)answer=answer*value%mod;for(int value=2;value<=n-count;++value)answer=answer*value%mod;return answer;} };
